actual.note: For 2002-03 to 2004-05 the Budget at a Glance counts repayments to the National Small Savings Fund and State Debt Swap Scheme transactions inside capital expenditure. These are debt transactions, not investment, and the RBI Handbook series (Table 89, note 2) treats them differently: for 2002-03 the difference is exactly the Rs 13,766 crore NSSF repayment; for 2003-04 and 2004-05 it is close to the amounts in RBI's note. Comparing capital spending across years? Treat these three years with care.

be_restated.note: Budget 2016-17 restated the 2015-16 Budget Estimate for grants for capital assets from 1,10,551 to 1,32,472 crore (its footnote: 'Deviation in BE 2015-16 is due to better capture of information'), but printed the effective revenue deficit as 2,68,000 crore, which matches neither figure (3,94,472 - 1,32,472 = 2,62,000). PDF and Excel copies agree, so this is in the source. The Budget Estimate shown on the site comes from Budget 2015-16, which is internally consistent.
